idea: A block on a spring oscillates about equilibrium; its period depends on the mass and the stiffness, never on how far it swings.

parameters.name: mass
parameters.why: Light to heavy blocks; zero mass has no motion to show.

parameters.name: stiffness
parameters.why: Soft to stiff springs with periods from a fraction of a second to a few seconds.

parameters.name: amplitude
parameters.why: Small to large swings that keep the spring from closing up against the wall.

moves: The block slides back and forth about equilibrium as the spring stretches and squeezes; the force arrow always points back toward equilibrium.
steps: Amplitude does not change the period
